meta.name: firebase-auth-basics
meta.description: Guide for setting up and using Firebase Authentication. Use this skill when the user's app requires user sign-in, user management, or secure data access using auth rules.

copy.tagline: 为应用添加账号登录与用户管理
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让应用支持用户注册登录和控制访问权限
copy.tagline_en: Add user login and account management to your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your app to support user sign-in and access control

howto.what: Claude 会指导你给应用接入 Firebase Authentication:配置登录方式(如 Google、邮箱密码)、部署 auth 配置、接入客户端 SDK,并用 request.auth 编写数据安全规则。
howto.when: 当你的应用需要用户登录、用户管理,或用安全规则控制数据访问时,它会接管;也可直接要求开启某个登录方式。

say.text: 帮我在 firebase.json 里开启 Google 登录和邮箱密码登录
say.note: 之后会提示你部署 auth 配置生效

say.text: 我的 Flutter 应用要接入 Firebase Auth,该怎么做
say.note: 会按 Flutter 参考文档给出步骤

say.text: 帮我写一条只允许登录用户读写的 Firestore 安全规则
say.note: 会基于 request.auth 给出规则示例

howto.what_en: Claude guides you through adding Firebase Authentication: configuring sign-in providers (Google, email/password, etc.), deploying auth config, wiring up client SDKs, and writing data security rules with request.auth.
howto.when_en: Use it when your app needs user sign-in, user management, or auth-rule-based data access, or when you ask to enable a specific sign-in provider.

say_en.text: Enable Google and email/password sign-in for me in firebase.json
say_en.note: Then it tells you to deploy the auth config

say_en.text: My Flutter app needs Firebase Auth, how do I set it up?
say_en.note: It follows the Flutter setup reference

say_en.text: Write a Firestore rule allowing only signed-in users to read and write
say_en.note: It gives rules based on request.auth
